title: Harden native workplan lifecycle and continuation tools
goal: Deliver all eight approved workplan improvements: complete native lifecycle, recoverable concurrent mutations, multiartifact checkpoint freshness, authoritative schemas, snapshot-bound compaction previews, real native permissions, bounded resume, and read-only doctor diagnostics without migrating existing V2 plans or losing handwritten content.
scope: Native create/update/inspect/validate/read/list/patch/reset alongside resume/checkpoint/compact, with planner and orchestrator ownership
Atomic per-file writes, expectedHash concurrency, cooperative writer locks, and recoverable multiartifact transactions for every mutation
Checkpoint hashes for JSON, linked Markdown, and specs; distinguish plan freshness from evidence verification
Authoritative document and input schemas shared by readers, writers, CLI checks, and native registrations with field-specific diagnostics
Compaction preview token bound to snapshot and exact removals, mandatory on apply with exact confirmation; separately authorized read-only previews
Real V2 path-sensitive permissions and cancellation handling, retaining existing custom safety guards
Bounded and paginated continuation packets with current work, dependency pointers, blockers, high findings, and unverified stale guardrails
Read-only workplan_doctor for canonical root, registrations, permissions, builtin plan conflict, and missing/invalid artifacts
nonGoals: Core plan schema migration or automatic rewrites/repairs of existing artifacts
Overwriting handwritten Markdown during ordinary metadata updates, compaction, or resume
System package installation, commits, push, deployment, service interruption, new agents, or unrelated cleanup
Re-enabling builtin opencode.plan or changing unrelated configuration and user modifications
Claiming test execution or evidence validity merely from hashes or structural validation
constraints: Canonical workspace /Users/cantabile/.config/opencode; preserve numeric schemaVersion 2 and existing statuses
Planner writes only this new JSON/Markdown pair until handoff; parent alone owns its execution updates

One core writer owns src/custom-tools/workplan/** and core tests; one native engineer owns public bridge/package/native tests independently, then adapter after core interfaces settle; no same-file concurrency
Parent captures existing Git status/diff before dispatch; planner has no shell or Git diff tool and has not run tests
Preserve -opencode.plan in opencode.json; no automatic configuration repairs by doctor
Use versioned checkpoint/dependency/transaction sidecars for richer metadata, not new mandatory core-plan fields
Never reclaim a live or ambiguously owned lock based only on age; recovery never overwrites externally edited bytes
Legacy expectedHash remains optional; native existing-state mutations require it and native create uses explicit must-be-absent preconditions
Fail closed if native exact-path authorization cannot be established using supported V2 runtime capabilities
Fresh-read every target immediately before surgical edits and regenerate patches after stale-state/context errors

Scoped dependency authorization: only packages/workplan-tools plugin/client pins to 2.0.20; no system install, bun install, root dependency rewrite or unrelated lockfile edits; retain installed legacy Zod 4.1.8

Public client bridge must prove this plugin instance/canonical location via in-memory RPC nonce and event-stream nonce readiness before exact-resource permission.create; discovery authentication alone is insufficient
Native writes require a usable invocation AbortSignal and definitive approval; reject/cancel/unsupported host fail closed, never permission.reply/rules overrides or broad permission fallback

phases.title: Settle contracts and harden the shared core

steps.title: Capture baseline and freeze approved core/bridge contracts
steps.target: Git working diff; approved public-client bridge and shared core interface contract
steps.action: Parent records tracked/untracked user changes and reuses supplied baseline/researcher/Oracle evidence. Freeze capability-gated public client bridge, plugin-instance/location nonce binding, event readiness, exact-resource permissions and AbortSignal contracts; dispatch disjoint core and bridge owners independently. Live bridge proof is native/public-permission-bridge, not a prerequisite for core implementation; do not repeat completed research.
steps.validation: Read-only Git status/diff and parent-reviewed contracts recorded; reuse 28 focused tests/134 assertions and passing typecheck. Public bridge architecture is settled, scoped 2.0.20 dependency authorization recorded, and native capability validation gates distinguished from independent core readiness.

steps.title: Unify schemas, snapshots, errors, and sidecar contracts
steps.action: Single core owner exports authoritative compatible document/input schemas using existing Zod 4.1.8, derives native JSON Schema/StandardSchema from shared definition.args, and adds executable structural refinements, field-specific errors, safe artifact discovery and planHash/stateHash snapshots. Define versioned checkpoint, dependency, journal, permission-intent and pagination contracts; wire core readers/writers/CLI to them without rewriting old plans.
steps.validation: Schema parity tests cover wrong types/status/version, ID mismatch/duplicates, incomplete drafts, optional legacy fields, preserved unknown metadata and field paths; CLI/read/native-ready inputs consume the same definitions; listing excludes recognized sidecars and reports invalid plans safely.

steps.title: Serialize and make every core mutation recoverable
steps.target: src/custom-tools/workplan/{shared,create,update,patch,reset,checkpoint,compact}.ts and new storage helpers; mutation tests
steps.action: Same core owner routes all mutation paths through one permission-intent, per-plan cooperative lock, expectedHash and atomic/journal engine with injected authorization/AbortSignal contract. Check cancellation before each operation/publication and completion; never commit after late approval. Add explicit update recovery mode and stale-lock safety; checkpoint-only and Markdown-only operations also serialize; preserve handwritten content unless explicitly confirmed replacement.
steps.validation: Fault injection after each transaction stage and separate-process writers demonstrate complete old/new states or explicit recovery-required diagnostics, no lost cooperating writes, denial/cancellation before content writes, safe abandoned locks, no external-edit overwrite during recovery, and no undeclared raw write bypass.

steps.title: Implement multiartifact freshness, preview binding, bounded resume, and doctor core
steps.action: Same core owner adds versioned multiartifact checkpoints, pure snapshot-bound preview tokens, fail-safe old checkpoints, bounded deterministic resume and dependency-sidecar retrieval, stale guardrail warnings, and read-only artifact/transaction doctor diagnostics with runtime facts injected by adapter.
steps.validation: JSON/Markdown/spec/checkpoint-only changes invalidate the correct hashes/tokens; old checkpoints cannot authorize apply; altered selections/removals/reason/token/confirmation fail before writes; large packets obey budget/pagination and retain high-risk counts/pointers; doctor and previews leave filesystem bytes and mtimes unchanged.

phases.title: Expose the native lifecycle with real authorization

steps.title: Implement and validate host-bound cancellable public permission bridge
steps.action: One native engineer independently implements public plugin/client 2.0.20 bridge after baseline-contracts. Bind authenticated discovered/explicit endpoint to THIS plugin instance/canonical location through scoped in-memory RPC nonce; prove event-stream nonce readiness before public permission.create on exact resources/session/agent/source. Wait real approval events; never reply or override rules. Require invocation AbortSignal, fail closed on unknown host/connection/no signal, expose doctor diagnostics, and obtain parent review plus disposable actual-host/cancel proof before write exposure.
steps.validation: Bridge tests cover nonce mismatch/cross-host, stream not ready/disconnected, definitive allow vs deny/reject/ask awaiting real reply, missing signal, cancellation plus late approval and abort races, exact resources/source correlation, endpoint/auth redaction and cleanup. Disposable live installed-runtime smoke proves host and event readiness/cancellation or records actionable BLOCKED; public package types alone do not prove host support.

steps.title: Register lifecycle, permissions, ownership, and runtime doctor facts
steps.action: Same native engineer starts adapter after both core/continuation-safety and parent-reviewed native/public-permission-bridge. Consume settled core exports and capability-gated public bridge; register lifecycle/doctor/pure preview alias using authoritative schemas, canonical root, trusted identity and concurrency preconditions. Pass signal through core, gate exact edit intents before all writes, and inject host/signal/connection diagnostics without self-granted approval or config repairs.
steps.validation: Catalog/schema/role matrix tests and actual disposable installed-runtime integration demonstrate complete lifecycle, host/stream proof, exact-path/session denials, real asks, cancellation plus late approval with no late commit, separately authorized read-only preview/doctor, canonical root and builtin conflict diagnostics. Unsupported installed host returns actionable fail-closed BLOCKED, not insecure fallback or proposal-only completion.
